relations.subject: search:index-aliases
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - extraction-layer predicate, minted once before in server/8.0/search/index-aliases.json for this exact mechanism
relations.evidence: An index alias points to one or more Full Text Indexes or to additional aliases: its purpose is therefore somewhat comparable to that of a symbolic link in a filesystem. Queries on an index alias are performed on all ultimate targets, and merged results are provided.

notable_absence.finding: No privilege documented for creating an index alias - the same gap the 7.2 twin flagged, still unaddressed in 8.0.

cross_component_finding: The sharpest finding of this batch: fts-create-index-aliases.md (this page, old fts/ generation) and search/create-search-index-alias.md + search/index-aliases.md (new search/ generation, both read in round 22) document the IDENTICAL task and mechanism - not a version-twin relationship (both are current 8.0 pages) and not a near-miss requiring disambiguation, but genuine content duplication within the same doc generation split this round's framing set out to investigate. Unlike fts-clone-index.md / fts-delete-index.md / fts-edit-index.md (whose tasks have no search/ equivalent at all - confirmed by checking server/current/search/ for edit/clone/delete pages and finding none), the alias-creation task was migrated to search/ AND left behind, unremoved, in fts/. This record reuses the search: ids rather than re-minting the 7.2 twin's fts:create-index-aliases id; reconciliation should fold the two.
cross_product_finding: No Capella/cloud twin exists for this specific fts/ page - Capella's docs have no fts/ tree at all - but cloud/search/create-search-index-alias.json already documents the same alias-creation task under the search: ids reused above, corroborating that this is genuinely one task with three documented instances (server/7.2/fts, server/8.0/fts [this page], server/8.0+cloud/search).
